title: rust-cargo-local-1: binary workspace members refuse extraction (src/lib.rs hardcoded)
description: Pilot finding (wild-xc4, testaruda release-tree extraction dry-run): wild extract refuses testaruda's exact release checkout with exit 2 input-mismatch: bundle file `adapter-typescript/src/lib.rs` unreadable. Root cause: parse_member_manifest (src/extract.rs ~L258) hardcodes source_path = <member>/src/lib.rs for every workspace member, but testaruda's members adapter-typescript and adapter-clojure are bin-only crates (src/main.rs). Cargo autodiscovery allows lib.rs OR main.rs (plus [[bin]] path overrides). Measured: request committed 528 files (git ls-files, all present); refusal names a file never committed. Rung-1 audit never saw this because crates.io ships only the root lib crate, wrapped in a synthetic workspace. Fix belongs in wild: resolve each member's crate-root source honoring autodiscovery (lib.rs else main.rs, honoring [lib]/[[bin]] path), keep honest gaps otherwise. Blocks the wild-xc4 pilot bundle step and every fleet attach-bundle ticket for repos with bin workspace members.
close_reason: Landed c01b734: parse_member_manifest resolves each member's crate-root source via Cargo autodiscovery ([lib] path override > committed src/lib.rs > committed src/main.rs); member with neither keeps honest input-mismatch naming both candidates. Red-first tests/runtime/test_extract.py (bin-only member reproduced the measured testaruda refusal verbatim, then green); docs/wild-local-v1.md member-resolution section. title: Consider format_args! for the argument-confined std macro whitelist
notes:
format_args! consideration — analysis complete, ADOPT recommended (pending user ruling):
SOUNDNESS: format_args! satisfies the whitelist criterion exactly as format! does — expansion is fmt::Arguments::new_v1 (closed std definition, no consumer-visible call sites); the demand surface is the syntactic argument expressions. Verified by probe: out.write_fmt(format_args!("v={} plus {}", x, x+1)) — the routed write_fmt call is an ordinary method call on a known binding, visited by the walker; nothing hidden.
FALLBACK (honest): named-argument form format_args!("{x} then {x}", x = x+2) does not parse as Punctuated<Expr, Comma> (x = expr is not an Expr) -> ArgumentExprList parse fails -> existing incomplete-demand gap. Same wrinkle already accepted for the print family under design decision 3's fallback; never guesses.
NESTED: inside a whitelisted macro's args, a whitelisted inner format_args! descends via the same whitelist path; non-whitelisted nested macros keep the gap (m7f.3 test case 3 semantics unchanged).
IMPACT: zero held-out delta (e5 cohort has no format_args! use) — this is whitelist-coherence work closing the RO5U M1 seam, not coverage work.
SCOPE per design.md note: adoption exceeds the approved add-std-macro-demand-support proposal semantics -> needs its own OpenSpec change (MODIFIED requirement scenario on wild-extract + red-first conformance fixture: positional-args descent case + named-arg fallback case). Mechanical implementation: one const entry + tests; extract.rs:35 ARGUMENT_CONFINED_STD_MACROS.
Recommendation: ADOPT via small OpenSpec slice, P3 sizing, red-first. Awaiting user ruling per repo proposal-approval discipline.
Proposal add-format-args-demand-support APPROVED by user post-RO5U (jev-1.13.0 verification: CORR-002 alias-capture hole verified@0.72, CORR-001 phase unpinned REVIEW_REQUIRED; both fixed in-bundle + EDGE-001 escaped-brace scan guard + EXCL-002). Proceeding red-first: fixtures 1.1 -> green (const entry + capture cross-check at demand-resolution time) -> meters -> disclosed held-out re-run (expected byte-identical) -> land.
EVIDENCE CORRECTION (probe-driven, pre-implementation): the RO5U-passed proposal wrongly claimed fn items implement Debug — compiler-refused (no Display/Debug/Pointer impl on fn items). The REAL capture hole is provider VALUE items: use provider::MAX + format_args!("max={MAX}") compiles (const/static, Display) and is walker-invisible; aliased form equally real. Fn-pointer flow via path expressions already disclosed by visit_expr_path. Design D4 evidence, spec scenario, tasks 1.1(d), and proposal Why all corrected in place (change still uncommitted); fixtures use a custom provider_lib with a pub const instead of the shared PROVIDER_LIB (adding a const to the shared lib could gap provider-side extraction).
